title: Equality of the Scott rank of a structure and of the Scott rank of its tree of tuples
author: David Gonzalez; Dino Rossegger
work: Scott sentence complexities of linear orderings
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the rank identity SR(A) = SR(T_A) for the replicated tree of tuples T_A (statement, source lines 309-311). Its work is the two-directional translation of Pi^in_alpha formulas (source lines 234-286) together with the orbit reconstruction at 312-332: an orbit in T_A must be described by a finite subtree plus the orbit formulas of its leaves, and the infinite replication of branches is what turns the resulting subtree isomorphism into an automorphism. A routine induction on tuples does not give this, because the class of trees of tuples is not definable inside the labeled trees and the pullback direction needs the parameterized embedding; the article says so explicitly at 287-293.
